definitions.gloss: exotic; foreign-flavored; with a foreign atmosphere
definitions.explanation: Having a pleasantly foreign look or atmosphere, used of places, food, music and people's faces.

examples.japanese: エキゾチックな⟦{顔立|かおだ}ち→顔立ち：14687_kaodachi⟧だ。
エキゾチックな⟦{雰囲気|ふんいき}→雰囲気：03604_funiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧だ。
examples.english: It's a town with an exotic atmosphere.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長崎|ながさき}→長崎：30731_nagasaki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{古|ふる}く→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{外国|がいこく}→外国：02868_gaikoku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{交流|こうりゅう}→交流：02732_kouryuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、エキゾチックな⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}く→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦{残|のこ}っている→残る：01187_nokoru⟧。
examples.english: Nagasaki has long had contact with other countries, so many exotic-looking buildings remain there.

notes:
From English "exotic".

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- エキゾチックな⟦{顔立|かおだ}ち→顔立ち：14687_kaodachi⟧: exotic (foreign-looking) features
- エキゾチックな⟦{雰囲気|ふんいき}→雰囲気：03604_funiki⟧: an exotic atmosphere
- エキゾチックな⟦{香|かお}り→香り：00189_kaori⟧: an exotic scent

WATCH OUT:
Calling a person's face エキゾチック is common in Japanese and meant as praise: it says the face looks un-Japanese, often Western or South Asian. English "exotic" said of a person can sound othering, so do not carry the compliment straight across.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{異国情緒|いこくじょうちょ}→異国情緒：32299_ikokujoucho⟧: exotic atmosphere, said of places; more literary
